reply.text: Nay, at least right after a heavy session if your goal is to keep building strength or size. Cold water right after lifting can blunt some of the muscle-building signal from the work you just did, so if you're chasing a bigger bench or squat, I'd keep the plunge a few hours away from the lifting or save it for a day you're not training. If you're using it purely for how you feel afterward, it's your call and a reasonable one, just know the trade-off.
